prerequisites: IGENI-EC0244 Structures électriques en courant continu
IGENI-EC0445 Circuits électriques en régime alternatif

learning_outcomes.text: Give the idealized input/output characteristic of the functional block performing the prescribed function.
Trace the temporal evolution, in time synchronism, of the input and output signals of a functional block, from its input/output characteristic.
Suggest a field of industrial application corresponding to a given electronic function.
Justify the linear or non-linear behaviour of an operational amplifier as a function of the types of feedback used.
Draw the diagram of a suitable structure enabling the desired function to be performed.
Establish the input/output relationship of the structure studied by applying the usual methods of analysis of electrical circuits.
Size the elements specific to the structure.
Identify the discrepancies between the material produced and the idealized functional behaviour expected.
Choose a suitable structure to produce the associated functional unit.
Size the components of the structure to enable it to meet the specifications.
Produce an assembly to validate experimentally the expected functional behaviour on teaching equipment.

syllabus_topics: Linear functions: Amplification, filtering, harmonic oscillator
Non-linear functions: Comparison, clipping, detection and temporal shaping
teaching_methods: Interactive class with active criticism of proposed solutions
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*DS1 + 1*TP1) / 3. Summative assessment in the form of a DS aims to evaluate theoretical skills acquired during the course and tutorials. Summative assessment at the end of the practical session aims to evaluate practical skills acquired during the session.
bibliography: Albert Paul Malvino, David J. Bates "Principes d'électronique - 9e édition", Dunod 2021
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
